AUD-REF-01.title: Unresolved references
AUD-REF-01.checks: Every {{variable}}, trigger ID and folder ID resolves to an entity or built-in.
AUD-REF-01.next: Define the missing variable or remove the reference, then re-export and re-run the audit. Do not publish while this stands.

AUD-OPQ-01.title: Opaque code
AUD-OPQ-01.checks: Custom HTML tags, custom JavaScript variables and sandboxed templates.
AUD-OPQ-01.next: Have a person read the code. Record its purpose and owner in the entity notes. Replace it with a built-in tag or template where one fits.

AUD-CON-01.title: No consent setting on a tag
AUD-CON-01.checks: Each tag has a consent status other than not set.
AUD-CON-01.next: Decide per tag whether it needs consent. Set the consent types, or set not needed and note why.

AUD-CON-02.title: Consent needed with no types
AUD-CON-02.checks: A tag marked needed lists at least one consent type.
AUD-CON-02.next: Add the consent types the tag depends on, for example analytics_storage or ad_storage, or change the status.

AUD-TRG-01.title: Tag with no firing trigger
AUD-TRG-01.checks: Each tag has at least one firing trigger.
AUD-TRG-01.next: Attach a trigger, or delete the tag if it is dead.

AUD-TRG-02.title: Unused trigger
AUD-TRG-02.checks: Each trigger is used by some tag as firing or blocking.
AUD-TRG-02.next: Delete it, or note what it is kept for.

AUD-VAR-01.title: Unused variable
AUD-VAR-01.checks: Each variable is referenced by something.
AUD-VAR-01.next: Delete it, or note what it is kept for.

AUD-TAG-01.title: Paused tag
AUD-TAG-01.next: Delete paused tags that have no planned return date.

AUD-TAG-02.title: liveOnly tag
AUD-TAG-02.checks: Tags marked liveOnly are listed, because Preview cannot observe them.
AUD-TAG-02.next: Add a canary plan for this tag. Do not treat a clean Preview run as coverage.

AUD-SRV-01.title: No client on a server container
AUD-SRV-01.next: Add the client that should claim your incoming requests, then replay sample requests.

AUD-SRV-02.title: Clients share a priority
AUD-SRV-02.checks: Client priorities are distinct, so claim order is explicit.
AUD-SRV-02.next: Give each client its own priority and replay sample requests to confirm the right client claims each one.
